description: Analyze sales and operational trends using Python, SQL, Excel, pandas, Power BI, and statistics. Clean datasets, create dashboards, communicate results, and present recommendations.
Build dashboards using Power BI and Tableau. Analyze metrics in Excel and SQL. Use data visualization and communication skills to explain business trends.
Build ETL data pipelines with Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, AWS, Git, and Airflow. Automate data cleaning and maintain reliable systems.
Build machine learning models using Python, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn and PyTorch. Use Git, FastAPI, statistics, and data preprocessing to evaluate and deploy models.
Automate IT workflows using Python, PowerShell, APIs, SQL and Git. Troubleshooting skills and communication are important. Create useful tools in Streamlit.
